description: Create a new DNS record for a subdomain. Supports A records (IP address), CNAME records (hostname) and REDIRECT records (an https:// URL — visitors to the name are sent there with a 301). Example: create demo.sitey.my pointing to 1.2.3.4. No account, API key or signup is needed. The target does not have to be serving yet: claim the name first and deploy to it second if that is your order. The result carries reachable:false when nothing answered, and the record is created either way. If you send no owner_token, the result carries a new one under 'owner_token' — save it, it is shown once and is the only way to change or delete this record later. Without an API key, a CNAME or REDIRECT may not point at a temporary tunnel (trycloudflare.com, ngrok and the like), names containing words such as login or wallet are refused with ACCOUNT_REQUIRED, and TXT records are not available.

owner_token.description: The owner token you were given when you created the record (starts with anon_). Omit it only if you have an API key, or if the record predates tokens and was claimed from this same IP address. Creating without one mints a new one and returns it once.

type.description: Record type. REDIRECT answers every visit with a 301 to the URL in value.

value.description: Record value: an IPv4 address for A, a hostname for CNAME, an absolute https:// URL for REDIRECT (http:// is refused, and so is a URL under one of this service's own roots).

name: create_subdomain
